limits.measurement: Completed host invocation brackets, including submission, possible descheduling, driver calls and synchronization; not CPU/GPU active occupancy.
limits.coverage: Intersection of recorded background invocation brackets with exact main windows. Inter-invocation gaps remain uncovered.
limits.causality: Descriptive post-hoc association only. Waiting caused by the main process can lengthen background brackets; coverage is not an exogenous load measurement.
limits.prediction: No fitting, heldout-derived predictor, interpolation, outlier filtering, automatic state classification or acceptance-gate changes.
limits.censoring: Full durations of every overlapping background invocation enter duration statistics; clipped segments enter coverage only. Edge censoring is reported.
limits.baseline: No owned replay is expected for baseline. This does not establish that the machine was idle.
